reviews.text: Terrible, and without expertise for two consecutive years in the summer periods my kitten showed abrasions due to continuous scratching due to the severe itching, it started in May every month I took him there and he continuously gave me the same cream that punctually did not help at all, just wasted money without even analyzing the fur with the microscope like my current vet does, terrible I absolutely do not recommend I would not even give one star👍

I highly recommend this clinic. The doctor saved the life of my 12-year-old cat, who had a truly complicated situation that no one else could have handled. He was incredibly kind, thorough, patient, knowledgeable, and empathetic. I was scared given the situation and my cat's age, but he uses a different anesthesiologist than other clinics and reassured me after running specific tests to obtain a complete clinical picture.

I'd heard great things about him, and I'm glad I trusted him. He's an excellent specialist in various fields. Many friends and family members have trusted him after my more than positive experience and have been impressed, making him stand out from other clinics and vets.
I will forever be grateful to him for saving what's most precious to me in life.

Truly competent doctor, he had already identified the problem before the results (which was later confirmed by the tests themselves).
In a few days, he got my cat back on his feet, and he's doing better than ever!

If it were possible, I wouldn't even give it the first star. I've been to five different vets, and they've all told me the same thing: that they didn't treat my dog ​​at all, and that, in fact, their poor work has made him worse. I'll stop here so as not to go any further with foul language. I ONLY TELL YOU: AVOID THIS VETERINARY CLINIC AS MUCH AS POSSIBLE!!!!!!!
